newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: Austria's central bank said on Thursday it would leave key interest rates unchanged and called for bids in one week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged 3.0 percent.
Bids have to be in by 1200 GMT on Friday.
Last week the central bank allotted 5.68 billion schillings, or six percent of bids, in one-week repos.
Austria's discount rate remains at 2.5 percent, the Lombard rate at 4.75 percent and the Gomex money market rate at 3.4 percent, central bank said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
